summary: Verified Lenis smooth scroll bug fix on the Sportily Tourism marketing site. Home page scrolls end-to-end (0 -> 3903 out of 4803 via mouse wheel; footer becomes visible). Lenis initialized correctly (html.lenis class present on / and /about). No console/page errors. /events and /about scroll cleanly after client-side navigation. Reveal sections (last 4) all have opacity 1 at bottom. Regression: Contact form submit shows contact-success; admin login (admin@sportily.travel / Sportily@2026) reaches /admin dashboard with 'Welcome back' toast. Backend not tested (per request).
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx Lenis init is correct (lerp:0.1, smoothWheel:true). scrollTo(0, {immediate:true}) on pathname change works as expected.
index.css contains the official Lenis CSS block near the top — good.

Consider removing the custom ::-webkit-scrollbar styles when Lenis is active if you want a fully hidden native scrollbar; currently the native scrollbar remains visible alongside Lenis, which is fine but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Created one contact lead 'TEST User / test@example.com' via /contact form during regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lenis scroll fix verified on iteration_4. html.lenis is applied on route changes; wheel scroll and JS scrollTo both work on /, /events, /about. Contact submit and admin login flows still green. Backend was intentionally skipped this iteration.
rca of the issue: Previous config used { duration: 1.15 } which combined with a missing official Lenis CSS caused the page to feel stuck / not scroll to bottom. Fix: switched to { lerp: 0.1, smoothWheel: true, wheelMultiplier: 1 } and added html.lenis{height:auto} + .lenis.lenis-smooth{scroll-behavior:auto} rules. Verified scrollY reaches 3903/4803 and footer visible via mouse wheel; no page errors.
